scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.coverage:rust: mkdir -p coverage && cargo llvm-cov --workspace --fail-under-lines 95 --fail-under-functions 95 --lcov --output-path coverage/rust.lcov && cargo llvm-cov report
scripts.format: bun run format:ts && bun run format:rust
scripts.format:check: bun run format:check:ts && bun run format:check:rust
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:rust
